note: Intext Question 9.1, 'Classify the following amines as primary, secondary or tertiary': four separate amines, no arrow between them. (i) and (ii) are drawn as naphthalene skeletons, two fused six-membered rings with alternating double bonds; in both the substituent sits on the ring carbon next to a ring-fusion carbon, i.e. the alpha (1-) position, (i) carrying NH2 and (ii) carrying N(CH3)2. (iii) and (iv) are printed as condensed formulae only, (C2H5)2CHNH2 and (C2H5)2NH, and are expanded as written: a CH bearing NH2 and two ethyls, and an NH bearing two ethyls. No structure is drawn for Question 9.2 below, which asks the reader to write them. The label field carries the printed enumerator because the book prints no compound names here. Nothing is drawn with a wedge or dash and no species has a stereocentre, so no stereochemistry is written.
